targets.props: compact feature="Tags (optional)" note="GCP resource tags (tagKeys/tagValues bindings) are a separate Resource Manager product Vyomi doesn't integrate with."
compact feature="Add turbo replication" note="Offered for dual-region buckets; Vyomi always uses default replication (RPO DEFAULT)."
compact feature="Autoclass" note="Vyomi keeps objects in the bucket's default class; storage classes don't change pricing or retrieval here."
compact feature="Enable hierarchical namespace on this bucket" note="Vyomi models every bucket as a flat namespace; it has no HNS mode with atomic folder rename/delete."

compact feature="Soft delete policy (For data recovery)" note="Retention duration defaults to 7 days, but recovering a deleted/overwritten object needs the noncurrent-version history Vyomi doesn't keep."
compact feature="Data encryption with Cloud KMS keys (CMEK)" note="Vyomi always encrypts new objects with a Google-managed key; it does not delegate envelope encryption to Cloud KMS."
